messages.text:
BL-1846 — A pack that declares config coordinator_mode deterministic has handoffd promote and route the next ticket itself when a slot opens, through the same gated promote_and_route_next.sh a model coordinator runs, instead of dropping an open-slot note for a model to read - the one hop of a mono-router's happy path that still needs a model coordinator
What it solves: ## The human's question, answered
Approval context: A new feature file, and the specifier's choice among the three shapes the human named in the intake (the intake left the choice to the specifier). Chosen: a deterministic coordinator, the shape the human said they prefer. FIRM: the daemon runs the same gated script a model coordinator runs, so ever…
BL-1846 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1846" (or "reject BL-1846 <reason>") to act.
